api_checks.description: F178 Admin lists users without any password or hash: admin token; items hold user_id, username, role, active, created_at and no hash. Evidence: backend pytest (test_admin_users_api.py, test_admin_checklists_api.py, test_queries_api.py, test_role_matrix.py) and e2e/live/ui-management.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010; staff logins analyst1, officer1, admin1 (demo-<user>-pass).

F179 Admin creates a staff user who can then sign in: admin token; body {username:'analyst.two', password:'synthetic-pass-123', role:'kyc-analyst'}; then that user logs in. Evidence: backend pytest (test_admin_users_api.py, test_admin_checklists_api.py, test_queries_api.py, test_role_matrix.py) and e2e/live/ui-management.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010; staff logins analyst1, officer1, admin1 (demo-<user>-pass).

F180 Invalid new user and duplicate username are rejected: admin token; body with username 'ab' and role 'prospect' names the offending fields; a repeat of an existing username is 409 USERNAME_TAKEN. Evidence: backend pytest (test_admin_users_api.py, test_admin_checklists_api.py, test_queries_api.py, test_role_matrix.py) and e2e/live/ui-management.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010; staff logins analyst1, officer1, admin1 (demo-<user>-pass).

F181 Admin changes a role and the change applies to issued tokens: admin token; body {role:'compliance-officer'}; an already issued token of that user then acts with the new role. Evidence: backend pytest (test_admin_users_api.py, test_admin_checklists_api.py, test_queries_api.py, test_role_matrix.py) and e2e/live/ui-management.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010; staff logins analyst1, officer1, admin1 (demo-<user>-pass).

F183 Admins cannot modify themselves; last active admin is protected: admin token of the same user; error code SELF_MODIFICATION.
